# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Extended the tank harness envelope API to cover reproduction metrics (`juveniles_count`, `berried_females_count`, `shrimp_reproductive_readiness`) and added `HarnessRun::from_state` so scenario-derived maintained variants can still use the standard trace/artifact flow. Updated `e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs` to add late-run nitrate guardrails for `nano_cycle`, `medium_planted`, and `warm_room`, replaced the loose light/dark DO check with a stricter lit-peak vs late-dark-trough assertion, and added a maintained `medium_planted` reproduction baseline that asserts a berried/juvenile reproduction window under shrimp-friendly overrides.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the baseline harness and scenario tests to confirm the missing reproduction coverage, missing nitrate guardrails, and the weak DO day/night assertion.
2. [Completed] Patched the harness and baseline e2e suite to add reproduction-aware envelope checks, explicit NO3 envelopes at mature checkpoints, a scenario-derived maintained reproduction run, and a stricter dark-vs-light DO regression.
3. [Completed] Ran formatting and package-level validation to confirm the updated harness and e2e scenarios pass together.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` completed successfully after the edits.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_baseline_scenarios -- --nocapture` passed all 8 baseline scenario tests, including the new reproduction-window test and the tightened DO regression.
- `cargo test -p tank_harness` passed the full `tank_harness` package test suite, including the new reproduction-envelope unit coverage and all existing e2e/discovery tests.

## Outstanding Risks

- Reproduction coverage currently relies on a scenario-derived maintained `medium_planted` variant with explicit reserve, mortality, and maturation tweaks; if the project later adds a first-class shrimp-husbandry preset, this guardrail should migrate to that preset.
